{{Quote|The devil you say, young Farsten. I have no intention of selling you the ''ou'tranoi'' for 100 credits, or indeed for any other sum. Although its powers are poorly understood, I have every faith it will prove to be vital to the completion of our mission.|Jackson Farseeker to Farsten|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Farsten''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who embarked on a mission with [[Jackson Farseeker]], a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Farseeker was in possession of an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] device known as the [[Ou'tranoi/Legends|''ou'tranoi'']]. Being an excellent bargainer, Farsten offered him a hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for it. Farseeker, however, refused to part with the device for any sum of [[Currency/Legends|money]].<ref name="RPG" />

==Personality and traits==
Farsten was a very good bargainer.<ref name="RPG" />
